responsibility: This file implements GCC’s runtime plugin subsystem: parsing and recording -fplugin and -fplugin-arg options, loading plugin shared objects, verifying plugin version/license metadata, maintaining the event-name table including dynamically allocated events, registering and invoking per-event callback chains, and reporting loaded-plugin versions/help/activity. It is the core dispatcher behind plugin.h/plugin.def, owning the plugin_name_args and callback bookkeeping, initialization/finalization flow, and user-facing diagnostics such as warnings when active plugins may affect bug reports.
same_name_distinction: Implements the plugin system’s runtime machinery—option parsing, shared-object loading, event-name storage, callback registration/invocation, and reporting—whereas gcc/plugin.h exposes the API/types and gcc/plugin.def is only the X-macro list of built-in plugin events.
